description: The bar chart, titled "Model Evaluation on Academic and Practical Benchmarks," compares the performance of two models—LLaMA-3-8B-it (blue bars) and Ours (Iterative RLHF) (orange bars)—across nine different datasets and metrics. The horizontal axis lists the datasets and metrics, including GSM-8K, MMLU, HumanEval, TruthfulQA, ARC, MBPP, LC AlpacaEval-2, MT-Bench (×5), and Chat-Arena-Hard. The vertical axis represents the score in percentage, ranging from 0 to 80. For most benchmarks, the orange bar (Ours) is taller than the blue bar (LLaMA-3-8B-it), indicating that the Iterative RLHF model achieved higher scores. Notably, the Ours model outperforms LLaMA-3-8B-it on GSM-8K, MMLU, HumanEval, TruthfulQA, ARC, MBPP, and MT-Bench. However, LLaMA-3-8B-it performs better on LC AlpacaEval-2 and Chat-Arena-Hard. The highest score for both models is on GSM-8K, with the Ours model achieving approximately 80%, while the LLaMA-3-8B-it model scores around 79%. The lowest scores are observed on Chat-Arena-Hard, where the Ours model scores around 29% and LLaMA-3-8B-it scores around 20%.
